title: Satellite reveals immense scale of GPS signal tampering
summary: A Space.com article reporting on satellite-based detection of GPS signal jamming and spoofing, revealing the problem is far more widespread than previously estimated. The technology uses satellites to monitor and map GPS interference globally, exposing significant threats to aviation, military operations, and critical infrastructure.
problem_solved: Quantifying and visualizing the global scale of GPS signal tampering that was previously difficult to detect and measure.
why_valuable: Provides critical awareness of a security vulnerability affecting navigation, aviation, and military systems worldwide.
